title: POINT2: A Polymer Informatics Training and Testing Database - code, benchmark splits and retrosynthesis templates
description: Code, fixed train/test splits, the template-based polymer retrosynthesis library with PolyScore, and the multi-seed benchmarking protocol for POINT2 (POlymer INformatics Training and Testing), a benchmark for polymer property prediction with uncertainty quantification, interpretability and synthesizability (Digital Discovery, 2026). PoLyInfo-derived property values are not redistributed; PoLyInfo identifiers and split assignments are provided instead.
